verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email marketing platform, since self-hostable products of this kind exist, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only the hosted SaaS with its API, SDKs, CLI, MCP and webhooks. Nothing indicates that MailerLite's core product can be deployed on user infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
